gloss: to be blocked; to be closed; to be occupied

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {塞|ふさ}がっていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be blocked; to be closed; to be plugged up
definitions.explanation: A passage, opening, or space is obstructed or shut. The intransitive counterpart of {塞|ふさ}ぐ (to block).

definitions.gloss: to be occupied; to be in use; to be taken
definitions.explanation: A seat, room, or resource is already being used and is therefore unavailable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{排水口|はいすいこう}→排水口：16250_haisuikou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{塞|ふさ}がって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{傷口|きずぐち}→傷口：09517_kizuguchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ようやく{塞|ふさ}がった。
⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{塞|ふさ}がって⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{迂回|うかい}→迂回：09034_ukai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The road was blocked due to an accident, so I took a detour.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{塞|ふさ}がって⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{両手|りょうて}→両手：09518_ryoute⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{塞|ふさ}がって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けて→開ける：00563_akeru⟧⟦もらえます→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: My hands are full, so could you open the door for me?

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議室|かいぎしつ}→会議室：01265_kaigishitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}→午前中：11495_gozenchuu⟧⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧{塞|ふさ}がって⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れなかった→取れる：02376_toreru⟧。
examples.english: The meeting room was occupied all morning, so I couldn't make a reservation.

notes:
{塞|ふさ}がる is an intransitive godan verb, the intransitive pair of ⟦{塞|ふさ}ぐ→塞ぐ：00046_fusagu⟧ (to block, to close).

ASPECT (ている):
{塞|ふさ}がって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes a resultant state — something is currently blocked or occupied.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{塞|ふさ}がる (something becomes blocked/occupied)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{塞|ふさ}がる (the road is blocked)
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{塞|ふさ}がる (one's hands are full)
- ⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{塞|ふさ}がる (a seat is occupied)
- ⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{塞|ふさ}がる (a wound closes up)

The expression ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{塞|ふさ}がって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (one's hands are full) is very common in daily conversation.
